answer: Use a notary-witnessed identity bond. A new agent books a 20-minute video session with a licensed notary, shows government ID, and reads a one-time code aloud. The notary signs one credential bound to that agent's key and publishes its hash. Renewal comes every 180 days, and any duplicate ID is flagged to all notaries. Forging 1,000 fakes costs $65,000 plus 333 hours of sessions, with each forged ID risking a fraud charge. A hollow profile with no stamp earns nothing, unlike an ivory-tower score gamed online. Like a harbor master checking papers before a voyage, no stamp means no sailing.
